title: crataegus calycina subsp. curvisepala
intro: Crataegus calycina subsp. curvisepala, commonly known as the Himalayan hawthorn, is a species of hawthorn tree native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antidiabetic agent. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus calycina subsp. curvisepala include cardiotonic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant may also have neuroprotective and antimicrobial effects, contributing to its medicinal properties.
